mapper.select: SELECT family_id, user_id, family_name, relation, birth_date FROM family WHERE family_id = #{familyId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT bracket_id, lower_bound, upper_bound, tax_rate, progressive_deduction FROM gift_tax_bracket WHERE effective_from <= #{asOfDate} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{asOfDate}) ORDER BY lower_bound

SELECT kb_product_data_version_id AS product_data_version_id, version_code, data_date, status, created_at, completed_at FROM kb_product_data_version WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY data_date DESC, kb_product_data_version_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT kb_product_data_version_id AS product_data_version_id, version_code, data_date, status, created_at, completed_at FROM kb_product_data_version WHERE kb_product_data_version_id = #{productDataVersionId}
mapper.sql: pv.kb_product_version_id AS product_version_id, pv.kb_product_data_version_id AS product_data_version_id, p.product_id, p.product_code, pv.product_name, p.product_type, pv.description, pv.product_url, pv.sales_status, dv.data_date AS product_data_date
mapper.select: SELECT , 'DEPOSIT' AS product_category, MAX(br.base_rate_percent) AS base_annual_rate_percent, MAX(br.max_rate_percent) AS maximum_annual_rate_percent, MAX(br.base_rate_percent) AS applied_annual_rate_percent, d.min_month, d.max_month, d.min_amount, d.max_amount FROM kb_product_version pv JOIN kb_product p ON p.product_id = pv.product_id JOIN kb_product_data_version dv ON dv.kb_product_data_version_id = pv.kb_product_data_version_id JOIN deposit d ON d.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id JOIN base_interest_rate br ON br.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id WHERE pv.kb_product_data_version_id = #{productDataVersionId} AND pv.sales_status = 'ON_SALE' AND p.product_type = 'DEPOSIT' GROUP BY pv.kb_product_version_id, pv.kb_product_data_version_id, p.product_id, p.product_code, pv.product_name, p.product_type, pv.description, pv.product_url, pv.sales_status, dv.data_date, d.min_month, d.max_month, d.min_amount, d.max_amount ORDER BY applied_annual_rate_percent DESC, pv.kb_product_version_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , s.savings_category AS product_category, MAX(br.base_rate_percent) AS base_annual_rate_percent, MAX(br.max_rate_percent) AS maximum_annual_rate_percent, MAX(br.base_rate_percent) AS applied_annual_rate_percent, s.min_month, s.max_month, s.monthly_min_amount, s.monthly_max_amount FROM kb_product_version pv JOIN kb_product p ON p.product_id = pv.product_id JOIN kb_product_data_version dv ON dv.kb_product_data_version_id = pv.kb_product_data_version_id JOIN savings s ON s.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id JOIN base_interest_rate br ON br.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id WHERE pv.kb_product_data_version_id = #{productDataVersionId} AND pv.sales_status = 'ON_SALE' AND p.product_type = 'SAVINGS' GROUP BY pv.kb_product_version_id, pv.kb_product_data_version_id, p.product_id, p.product_code, pv.product_name, p.product_type, pv.description, pv.product_url, pv.sales_status, dv.data_date, s.savings_category, s.min_month, s.max_month, s.monthly_min_amount, s.monthly_max_amount ORDER BY applied_annual_rate_percent DESC, pv.kb_product_version_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , e.etf_category AS product_category, e.annual_return_10y AS base_annual_rate_percent, e.annual_return_10y AS maximum_annual_rate_percent, e.annual_return_10y AS applied_annual_rate_percent, e.tracking_index, e.annual_return_10y AS annualized_return_10y_percent, e.bond_ratio AS bond_ratio_percent, e.risk_level FROM kb_product_version pv JOIN kb_product p ON p.product_id = pv.product_id JOIN kb_product_data_version dv ON dv.kb_product_data_version_id = pv.kb_product_data_version_id JOIN etf e ON e.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id WHERE pv.kb_product_data_version_id = #{productDataVersionId} AND pv.sales_status = 'ON_SALE' AND p.product_type = 'ETF' AND ( #{riskProfile} = 'AGGRESSIVE' OR (#{riskProfile} = 'BALANCED' AND e.risk_level IN ('EX_LOW', 'LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH')) OR (#{riskProfile} = 'CONSERVATIVE' AND e.etf_category = 'BOND_MIXED' AND e.risk_level IN ('EX_LOW', 'LOW', 'MEDIUM')) ) ORDER BY e.annual_return_10y DESC, pv.kb_product_version_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO simulation ( kb_product_data_version_id, family_id, requested_amount, status, tax_payment_method, investment_period_months, as_of_date, gift_date, investment_end_date, calculation_version, formula_version, version, selected_portfolio_id, previous_gift_amount, deduction_limit, deduction_renewal_date, created_at, updated_at, saved_at, expired_at ) VALUES ( #{productDataVersionId}, #{familyId}, #{requestedAmount}, #{status}, #{taxPaymentMethod}, #{investmentPeriodMonths}, #{asOfDate}, #{giftDate}, #{investmentEndDate}, #{calculationVersion}, #{formulaVersion}, #{version}, NULL, #{previousGiftAmount}, #{deductionLimit}, #{deductionRenewalDate}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, NULL, #{expiredAt} )

INSERT INTO simulation_tranche ( simul_result_id, sequence_no, gift_date, gift_amount, estimated_gift_tax, donor_required_amount, investment_amount, created_at ) VALUES ( #{resultId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{giftDate}, #{giftAmount}, #{estimatedGiftTax}, #{donorRequiredAmount}, #{investmentAmount}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE simulation_portfolio SET expected_future_value = #{expectedFutureValue}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE simul_portfolio_id = #{portfolioId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO simulation_product ( simul_portfolio_id, kb_product_version_id, is_selected, allocated_amount, applied_annual_rate, expected_future_value, created_at ) VALUES ( #{portfolioId}, #{productVersionId}, #{selected}, #{allocatedAmount}, #{appliedAnnualRatePercent}, #{expectedFutureValue}, NOW() )
mapper.sql: s.simul_id AS simulation_id, s.kb_product_data_version_id AS product_data_version_id, s.family_id, f.user_id, f.family_name, f.relation, f.birth_date, s.requested_amount, s.status, s.tax_payment_method, s.investment_period_months, s.as_of_date, s.gift_date, s.investment_end_date, s.calculation_version, s.formula_version, s.version, s.selected_portfolio_id, s.previous_gift_amount, s.deduction_limit, s.deduction_renewal_date, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.saved_at, s.expired_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM simulation s JOIN family f ON f.family_id = s.family_id WHERE s.simul_id = #{simulationId}
SELECT FROM simulation s JOIN family f ON f.family_id = s.family_id WHERE s.family_id = #{familyId} AND s.status = 'SAVED' ORDER BY s.saved_at DESC, s.simul_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT simul_result_id AS result_id, simul_id AS simulation_id, scenario_type, deduction_amount, taxable_amount, gift_tax, donor_required_amount, post_tax_amount, investment_principal, created_at FROM simulation_result WHERE simul_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY simul_result_id

SELECT t.tranche_id, t.simul_result_id AS result_id, t.sequence_no, t.gift_date, t.gift_amount, t.estimated_gift_tax, t.donor_required_amount, t.investment_amount, t.created_at FROM simulation_tranche t JOIN simulation_result r ON r.simul_result_id = t.simul_result_id WHERE r.simul_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY t.simul_result_id, t.sequence_no
mapper.sql: sp.simul_portfolio_id AS portfolio_id, sp.simul_result_id AS result_id, sr.simul_id AS simulation_id, sr.scenario_type, sp.portfolio_type, sp.deposit_amount, sp.savings_amount, sp.etf_amount, sp.expected_future_value, sp.is_recommended AS recommended, sp.created_at, sp.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM simulation_portfolio sp JOIN simulation_result sr ON sr.simul_result_id = sp.simul_result_id WHERE sr.simul_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY sr.simul_result_id, sp.portfolio_type
SELECT FROM simulation_portfolio sp JOIN simulation_result sr ON sr.simul_result_id = sp.simul_result_id WHERE sp.simul_portfolio_id = #{portfolioId}
mapper.sql: spr.simulation_product_id, spr.simul_portfolio_id AS portfolio_id, spr.kb_product_version_id AS product_version_id, p.product_id, p.product_code, pv.product_name, p.product_type, CASE WHEN p.product_type = 'DEPOSIT' THEN 'DEPOSIT' WHEN p.product_type = 'SAVINGS' THEN sv.savings_category ELSE e.etf_category END AS product_category, spr.is_selected AS selected, spr.allocated_amount, spr.applied_annual_rate AS applied_annual_rate_percent, spr.expected_future_value, COALESCE(MAX(br.base_rate_percent), e.annual_return_10y) AS base_annual_rate_percent, COALESCE(MAX(br.max_rate_percent), e.annual_return_10y) AS maximum_annual_rate_percent, e.risk_level, COALESCE(d.min_month, sv.min_month) AS minimum_contract_months, COALESCE(d.max_month, sv.max_month) AS maximum_contract_months, spr.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM simulation_product spr JOIN simulation_portfolio sp ON sp.simul_portfolio_id = spr.simul_portfolio_id JOIN simulation_result sr ON sr.simul_result_id = sp.simul_result_id JOIN simulation s ON s.simul_id = sr.simul_id JOIN kb_product_version pv ON pv.kb_product_version_id = spr.kb_product_version_id JOIN kb_product p ON p.product_id = pv.product_id LEFT JOIN deposit d ON d.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id LEFT JOIN savings sv ON sv.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id LEFT JOIN etf e ON e.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id LEFT JOIN base_interest_rate br ON br.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id WHERE sr.simul_id = #{simulationId} GROUP BY spr.simulation_product_id, spr.simul_portfolio_id, spr.kb_product_version_id, p.product_id, p.product_code, pv.product_name, p.product_type, sv.savings_category, e.etf_category, e.annual_return_10y, e.risk_level, d.min_month, d.max_month, sv.min_month, sv.max_month, spr.is_selected, spr.allocated_amount, spr.applied_annual_rate, spr.expected_future_value, spr.created_at ORDER BY spr.simul_portfolio_id, p.product_type, spr.expected_future_value DESC

SELECT FROM simulation_product spr JOIN simulation_portfolio sp ON sp.simul_portfolio_id = spr.simul_portfolio_id JOIN simulation_result sr ON sr.simul_result_id = sp.simul_result_id JOIN simulation s ON s.simul_id = sr.simul_id JOIN kb_product_version pv ON pv.kb_product_version_id = spr.kb_product_version_id JOIN kb_product p ON p.product_id = pv.product_id LEFT JOIN deposit d ON d.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id LEFT JOIN savings sv ON sv.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id LEFT JOIN etf e ON e.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id LEFT JOIN base_interest_rate br ON br.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id WHERE spr.simul_portfolio_id = #{portfolioId} GROUP BY spr.simulation_product_id, spr.simul_portfolio_id, spr.kb_product_version_id, p.product_id, p.product_code, pv.product_name, p.product_type, sv.savings_category, e.etf_category, e.annual_return_10y, e.risk_level, d.min_month, d.max_month, sv.min_month, sv.max_month, spr.is_selected, spr.allocated_amount, spr.applied_annual_rate, spr.expected_future_value, spr.created_at ORDER BY p.product_type, spr.expected_future_value DESC

SELECT FROM simulation_product spr JOIN simulation_portfolio sp ON sp.simul_portfolio_id = spr.simul_portfolio_id JOIN simulation_result sr ON sr.simul_result_id = sp.simul_result_id JOIN simulation s ON s.simul_id = sr.simul_id JOIN kb_product_version pv ON pv.kb_product_version_id = spr.kb_product_version_id JOIN kb_product p ON p.product_id = pv.product_id LEFT JOIN deposit d ON d.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id LEFT JOIN savings sv ON sv.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id LEFT JOIN etf e ON e.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id LEFT JOIN base_interest_rate br ON br.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id WHERE spr.simulation_product_id = #{simulationProductId} GROUP BY spr.simulation_product_id, spr.simul_portfolio_id, spr.kb_product_version_id, p.product_id, p.product_code, pv.product_name, p.product_type, sv.savings_category, e.etf_category, e.annual_return_10y, e.risk_level, d.min_month, d.max_month, sv.min_month, sv.max_month, spr.is_selected, spr.allocated_amount, spr.applied_annual_rate, spr.expected_future_value, spr.created_at

SELECT pv.kb_product_version_id AS product_version_id, pv.kb_product_data_version_id AS product_data_version_id, p.product_id, p.product_code, pv.product_name, p.product_type, pv.description, pv.product_url, pv.sales_status, d.min_amount AS minimum_amount, d.max_amount AS maximum_amount, COALESCE(d.min_month, sv.min_month) AS minimum_months, COALESCE(d.max_month, sv.max_month) AS maximum_months, sv.savings_category, sv.monthly_min_amount AS monthly_minimum_amount, sv.monthly_max_amount AS monthly_maximum_amount, e.stock_code, e.etf_category, e.tracking_index, e.annual_return_10y AS annualized_return_10y_percent, e.bond_ratio AS bond_ratio_percent, e.risk_level FROM kb_product_version pv JOIN kb_product p ON p.product_id = pv.product_id LEFT JOIN deposit d ON d.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id LEFT JOIN savings sv ON sv.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id LEFT JOIN etf e ON e.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id WHERE pv.kb_product_version_id = #{productVersionId}

SELECT base_interest_rate_id, kb_product_version_id AS product_version_id, min_month AS minimum_months, max_month AS maximum_months, base_rate_percent, max_rate_percent AS maximum_rate_percent FROM base_interest_rate WHERE kb_product_version_id = #{productVersionId} ORDER BY min_month, base_interest_rate_id

SELECT preferential_interest_rate_id, kb_product_version_id AS product_version_id, additional_rate_percent, condition_code, preferential_condition AS description FROM preferential_interest_rate WHERE kb_product_version_id = #{productVersionId} ORDER BY condition_code

SELECT pir.preferential_interest_rate_id, pir.kb_product_version_id AS product_version_id, pir.additional_rate_percent, pir.condition_code, pir.preferential_condition AS description FROM simulation_product_preferential_condition sppc JOIN preferential_interest_rate pir ON pir.preferential_interest_rate_id = sppc.preferential_interest_rate_id WHERE sppc.simulation_product_id = #{simulationProductId} ORDER BY pir.condition_code

SELECT holding_id, kb_product_version_id AS product_version_id, holding_rank, holding_name, holding_code, asset_type, country_code, weight_percent FROM etf_holding WHERE kb_product_version_id = #{productVersionId} ORDER BY holding_rank LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM simulation s JOIN family f ON f.family_id = s.family_id WHERE ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.simul_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM simulation s JOIN family f ON f.family_id = s.family_id WHERE
mapper.update: UPDATE simulation_product spr JOIN simulation_portfolio sp ON sp.simul_portfolio_id = spr.simul_portfolio_id JOIN simulation_result sr ON sr.simul_result_id = sp.simul_result_id SET spr.is_selected = 0 WHERE sr.simul_id = #{simulationId}
mapper.delete: DELETE sppc FROM simulation_product_preferential_condition sppc JOIN simulation_product spr ON spr.simulation_product_id = sppc.simulation_product_id JOIN simulation_portfolio sp ON sp.simul_portfolio_id = spr.simul_portfolio_id JOIN simulation_result sr ON sr.simul_result_id = sp.simul_result_id WHERE sr.simul_id = #{simulationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE simulation SET status = 'SAVED', selected_portfolio_id = #{selectedPortfolioId}, saved_at = #{savedAt}, updated_at = #{savedAt}, expired_at = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE simul_id = #{simulationId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
UPDATE simulation SET status = 'DRAFT', saved_at = NULL, expired_at = #{expiredAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE simul_id = #{simulationId} AND status = 'SAVED'
